changes: Pólizas reads each scoped polizas/clientes/vehiculos/aseguradoras/asesores collection once per index revision.
Country filtering, search text, filter options and visible relation cells consume the same in-memory index.
The first 100 rows no longer perform K.clienteCell/K.aseguradoraCell/K.asesorCell per-row store.get lookups.
Direct filter/pagination/search rerenders re-enter the canonical Polizas access scope.
Approved table hierarchy/labels/actions remain unchanged; only relation data resolution and cache binding changed.
